gloss: advance payment; prepaid expense; money paid up front

definitions.gloss: advance payment; prepaid expense; money paid up front
definitions.explanation: Money handed over before goods are delivered or services are performed. In accounting it is carried as an asset until the goods or services are actually received.

examples.japanese: {前払金|まえばらいきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支払|しはら}った→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧。
{契約時|けいやくじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{前払金|まえばらいきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
examples.english: An advance payment is required when the contract is signed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{前払金|まえばらいきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{総額|そうがく}→総額：05472_sougaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{三割|さんわり}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{決|き}まっている→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: The advance payment for the construction work is set at 30% of the total.

notes:
An accounting and business term for money paid ahead of delivery. It is the money itself, not the practice of paying early.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前払金|まえばらいきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支払|しはら}う→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧: to pay an advance
- {前払金|まえばらいきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧: to receive an advance
- {前払金|まえばらいきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{返還|へんかん}→返還：14357_henkan⟧: return of an advance payment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{前払|まえばら}い→前払い：15782_maebarai⟧: advance payment — the act or arrangement of paying early
- ⟦{内金|うちきん}→内金：30223_uchikin⟧: part payment — a portion of the price paid first, with the balance to follow
- ⟦{手付金|てつけきん}→手付金：29465_tetsukekin⟧: deposit — secures a contract and may be forfeited if the buyer backs out
